config:
[apps]
quit=["Quit Demo"]
freeze=["Freeze Demo"]
skip=["Skip Demo"]
ask=["Ask Demo"]
default="skip"
[[apps.with_daemon]]
name="Remote Demo"
group="network"
system_daemons=["<ROOT>/org.demo.daemon.plist"]
[network]
apps=["Network Demo", "Remote Demo"]
[services]
unload=["org.demo.worker"]
[options]
language="en"
